title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.11750v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inferen

translated_title: 草稿树在何处丢失目标质量：退出引导的推测解码
translated_abstract: 基于树的推测解码可在一次目标模型前向传递中验证多个草稿延续，但由草稿分数构建的有限树面临根本性的草稿-目标失配问题。我们探究更好的精确验证能否在固定树上提高接受率，以及目标反馈如何改进树本身。通过目标流视角，我们识别出一个规范的退出定律，并证明“1加上目标覆盖率”严格界定任何精确路径验证器的期望输出块长度（包括奖励 token）。所有最优验证器都遵循相同的退出与奖励 token 定律，而代表性的预抽取-跟随验证器和顺序残差验证器已经达到该定律。由此我们提出树退出验证，这是一种精确的、层级并行的过程，仅使用一次退出节点决策和一次奖励 token 决策。该退出定律还能识别缺失的目标概率，为推理时退出引导下的草稿树训练提供节点级反馈。
tldr: 该论文提出树退出验证（TEV）与退出引导草稿树训练，通过识别“退出定律”证明目标覆盖率严格界定精确验证器的期望输出块长度，从而提升推测解码的接受率并为草稿树提供节点级改进反馈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Tree Exit Verification (TEV) and ExitTrain, identifying a canonical "exit law" proving that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length of any exact verifier, thereby boosting acceptance and providing node-level feedback to improve draft trees in speculative decoding.
